text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: There's no need to beat yourself up!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just 'cause I lost this time doesn't
mean I'll
stay down forever!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'll win the next one and treat my little
sister back
home to a mountain of
delicious white rice!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But just rice won't cut it! I'll give her
some yummy
pickled daikon radish for a
side as well!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! Time to get me a
boatload of
daikon radishes so I can
pickle 'em all!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: That might be true, but still!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
My little sis is still waiting for me back in
my
hometown! I can't go back
empty-handed!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! I'll catch a kappa for her as
a
souvenir!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You know what that means, Trainer! We
gotta get
some cucumbers for bait!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
We go to the shopping district, buy
some daikon
radishes and yellowtail, and
make a nice meal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп and I head to the shopping
district,
buy ten cucumbers, and then
eat them—lightly
salted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
